title: Mega Great League
rules: Pokemon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.

title: Mega Ultra League
rules: Pokemon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.

title: Willpower Cup
rules: Pokemon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Only Fighting-, Psychic-, and Dark-type Pokémon are eligible.
The following Pokemon are not allowed: Gardevoir, Zorua, Zoroark.

title: LAIC 2027 Championship Series Cup
rules: Pokemon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
Allowed Types: All besides those explicitly prohibited.
Allowed Categories: Shadow Pokemon, Mega Evolution and Primal Reversion Pokemon. All Mega Evolution Pokémon are eligible even if they would otherwise be prohibited by a species, typing, or category.
Prohibited Types: Dark, Fairy, Fire, Steel.
Prohibited Categories: Legendary, Mythical, Ultra Beasts.
Prohibited Pokemon: Altaria, Annihilape, Araquanid, Chansey, Clodsire, Corsola (Galarian), Dusclops, Furret, Jellicent, Kingdra, Medicham, Oranguru, Snorlax, Wobbuffet, Mega Sableye.

title: Master Premier Cup
rules: Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.
